verdict.rationale: As a search platform, Meilisearch could plausibly offer user-configurable background automations, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no feature that lets users define, schedule, or run autonomous recurring automations. The closest items are automatic embedding generation, a fixed indexing behavior, and database-sync integrations (Meilisync, Rails/Firebase sync). These are adjacent features, not a general background-automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
